post.caption: One diamond became 26 flawless stones. The Lesotho Promise was found in August 2006 at the Letseng mine in Lesotho, about 3,100 meters above sea level. The rough stone weighed 603 carats and was D color. Graff bought it, and 35 people planned how to cut it. All 26 stones are D color and flawless or internally flawless. The biggest is a 76.41 carat pear. Together they weigh about 224 carats, and all 26 hang together in one white gold necklace.
